notes: Prior spreadsheet labels were hints. Each source was read and accepted only when the text could support a synopsis and five single-best-answer MCQs.
One stored document was accepted: NICE NG219 in data/question-repair-source-import.json for catalogue 2057.
Shared curated-topic-mcqs indexes were not edited.

Partial coverage is recorded on the topic, not counted as unresolved: catalogue 896 has no shared-decision protocol; catalogue 92 has no revision-rate table; catalogue 1168 does not name Beck's triad; catalogue 1129 has no viscosity threshold.

topics.topic: NSAID gastrointestinal and renal toxicity: COX-2 selectivity, PPI co-prescription, renal monitoring
topics.title: Safe prescribing of non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs in patients with osteoarthritis – an expert consensus addressing benefits as well as gastrointestinal and cardiovascular risks
topics.coverageNote: Gastrointestinal risk reduction, COX-2 selection, and PPI co-prescription are explicit. Renal toxicity is named, but no monitoring interval is given, so none was invented.

topics.topic: NSAID therapy in axSpA: continuous vs on-demand, radiographic progression
topics.title: Nonsteroidal Antiinflammatory Drugs as Potential Disease-Modifying Medications in Axial Spondyloarthritis
topics.coverageNote: Covers continuous versus on-demand NSAID use and radiographic progression. The two trials disagree, and that disagreement is preserved rather than resolved by adding numbers that are not in the review.

topics.topic: Neonatal Lupus and Congenital Heart Block
topics.title: A review of neonatal lupus syndrome
topics.coverageNote: Same open review is used for catalogue 1934 with different questions. ACR 2020 reproductive-health guideline PMIDs in the spreadsheet did not resolve to that paper in Europe PMC.

topics.topic: Neonatal lupus: anti-Ro, anti-La, congenital heart block, counselling
topics.title: A review of neonatal lupus syndrome
topics.coverageNote: Questions emphasize antibody pattern, preconception drugs, and surveillance. Numeric risks are those stated in the review.

topics.topic: Neuropsychiatric SLE
topics.title: Neuropsychiatric Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Systematic Review
topics.coverageNote: EULAR 2010 NPSLE recommendations were not in PMC. This systematic review is the open full text that covers syndromes and the immunosuppression-versus-anticoagulation split.

topics.topic: Neuropsychiatric SLE: NPSLE syndromes, attribution, immunosuppression vs anticoagulation
topics.title: Neuropsychiatric Systemic Lupus Erythematosus: A Systematic Review
topics.coverageNote: Questions focus on when the review uses immunosuppression versus anticoagulation. No attribution score was invented.

topics.topic: ORAL Surveillance trial: cardiovascular safety of tofacitinib vs TNFi in RA
topics.title: Risk of major adverse cardiovascular events with tofacitinib versus tumour necrosis factor inhibitors in patients with rheumatoid arthritis
topics.coverageNote: The NEJM primary paper was not open on PMC. This open paper reports the ORAL Surveillance cardiovascular comparison and is used only for figures it states.

topics.topic: Osteoarthritis
topics.title: 2019 American College of Rheumatology/Arthritis Foundation Guideline for the Management of Osteoarthritis of the Hand, Hip, and Knee
topics.coverageNote: Management guideline. Pathophysiology and Kellgren-Lawrence grading are not its subject; those are covered for catalogue 723 by a separate review.

topics.topic: Osteoarthritis: pathophysiology, risk factors, radiographic grading, pharmacological management
topics.title: Diagnosis and Treatment of Hip and Knee Osteoarthritis: A Review
topics.coverageNote: Covers risk factors, Kellgren-Lawrence grading, and drug therapy. It is a review, not a society guideline.

topics.topic: Osteopetrosis
topics.title: Autosomal dominant osteopetrosis
topics.coverageNote: The 2017 osteopetrosis working-group consensus was not free full text. This open review covers adult autosomal-dominant disease and states how infantile recessive disease is treated differently.

topics.topic: Pegloticase and lesinurad in refractory gout: indications, infusion reactions
topics.title: 2020 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Management of Gout
topics.coverageNote: Pegloticase indications and allergic/infusion burden are explicit. Lesinurad is covered as a withdrawn-but-still-approved drug whose data were considered; a dosing regimen was not copied from memory.

topics.topic: Perioperative management of RA: holding DMARDs and biologics for surgery
topics.title: Perioperative management of immunosuppression in patients with rheumatoid arthritis
topics.coverageNote: Gives continue-versus-hold rules and two biologic examples. The 2022 ACR/AAHKS update was not an open PMC full text, so newer changes after 2019 are not added.

topics.topic: Plantar Fasciitis and Calcaneal Spurs
topics.title: Plantar Fasciitis: An Updated Review
topics.coverageNote: Diagnosis, spur interpretation, and examination are grounded. A specific first-line injection protocol was not quoted because a clear 'first-line' sentence was not used.

topics.topic: Polymyositis differentiation
topics.title: 2017 European League Against Rheumatism/American College of Rheumatology classification criteria for adult and juvenile idiopathic inflammatory myopathies and their major subgroups
topics.coverageNote: Differentiates polymyositis within the inflammatory myopathy subgroups using the 2017 probability model. Polymyalgia rheumatica referral criteria were not used.

topics.topic: Pulmonary arterial hypertension in connective tissue disease: screening, ERA, PDE5 inhibitors
topics.title: Pulmonary Arterial Hypertension In Systemic Sclerosis: Challenges In Diagnosis, Screening And Treatment
topics.coverageNote: Screening rationale plus ERA and PDE5 evidence are in one review. DETECT score cut-offs are not copied unless stated in the sentences used.

topics.topic: Pyoderma Gangrenosum
topics.title: Pyoderma Gangrenosum: An Updated Literature Review on Established and Emerging Pharmacological Treatments
topics.coverageNote: Diagnosis frameworks and first-line systemic therapy are both in the review. A short 'guide to diagnosis' PMC record contained only an abstract and was not used.

topics.topic: RA in pregnancy: disease course, drug safety, biologics, MTX cessation
topics.title: Management of rheumatoid arthritis during pregnancy: challenges and solutions
topics.coverageNote: Drug-safety statements are taken from this review. A 2020 ACR reproductive guideline was not the open full text retrieved.

topics.topic: RA treat-to-target strategy: DAS28, SDAI, CDAI remission thresholds
topics.title: Treating rheumatoid arthritis to target: 2014 update of the recommendations of an international task force
topics.coverageNote: DAS28 <2.6 is the numeric threshold explicitly used. SDAI and CDAI are named; their numeric cut-offs are not invented.

topics.topic: Relapsing Polychondritis
topics.title: Relapsing Polychondritis: An Updated Review
topics.coverageNote: Clinical review used because the short PMC record titled only 'Relapsing Polychondritis' was under 2,000 characters.

topics.topic: RA and cardiovascular risk: accelerated atherosclerosis, NSAIDs, coxib caution
topics.title: Cardiovascular safety of celecoxib in rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis patients: A systematic review and meta-analysis
topics.coverageNote: Connects accelerated coronary atherosclerosis in RA with the coxib safety question. The EULAR 2016 cardiovascular-risk recommendations were not open on PMC.

topics.topic: Remission maintenance in AAV: azathioprine, rituximab, MAINRITSAN trial
topics.title: Rituximab versus azathioprine for maintenance of remission for patients with ANCA-associated vasculitis and relapsing disease: an international randomised controlled trial
topics.coverageNote: The MAINRITSAN trial report itself was not open. This paper is accepted only for the MAINRITSAN results it explicitly states. RITAZAREM efficacy numbers are not presented as MAINRITSAN results.

topics.topic: Rituximab in rheumatic disease: dosing, pre-treatment screening, hypogammaglobulinaemia
topics.title: Rituximab for Rheumatoid Arthritis
topics.coverageNote: Screening and hypogammaglobulinemia are explicit. A separate hypogammaglobulinemia cohort used a 2×1 g then 1 g every 6 months schedule; that dosing schedule is not imported into this paper's MCQs.

topics.topic: Rotator Cuff Tendinopathy and Adhesive Capsulitis
topics.title: Current Non-operative Management of Shoulder Pathologies: A Narrative Review
topics.coverageNote: One review covers both named conditions. It does not give operative indications.

topics.topic: SLE flare vs infection: distinguishing features, complement, anti-dsDNA, CRP
topics.title: The ratio of erythrocyte sedimentation rate to C-reactive protein is useful in distinguishing infection from flare in systemic lupus erythematosus
topics.coverageNote: Uses complement and anti-dsDNA as markers that do not track CRP, plus the ESR:CRP ratio. It is a cohort study, not a diagnostic guideline.

topics.topic: SLE: SLICC 2012 and ACR/EULAR 2019 classification criteria compared
topics.title: 2019 European League Against Rheumatism/American College of Rheumatology classification criteria for systemic lupus erythematosus
topics.coverageNote: Direct comparison of the 2019 structure with SLICC 2012 and ACR 1997. The SLICC derivation paper alone cannot describe the 2019 criteria.

topics.topic: Scleroderma ILD: HRCT patterns, nintedanib, mycophenolate, cyclophosphamide
topics.title: Expert consensus on the management of systemic sclerosis-associated interstitial lung disease
topics.coverageNote: HRCT is the diagnostic standard in the cited consensus. Pattern-subtype frequencies are not invented.

topics.topic: Scleroderma Renal Crisis
topics.title: Renal Disease and Systemic Sclerosis: an Update on Scleroderma Renal Crisis
topics.coverageNote: Same open update is used for catalogue 1510. UKSSG 2015 was not the open full text retrieved.

topics.topic: Scleroderma renal crisis: ACE inhibitors, hypertensive emergency, captopril
topics.title: Renal Disease and Systemic Sclerosis: an Update on Scleroderma Renal Crisis
topics.coverageNote: Questions are limited to ACE-inhibitor choice, titration, and pregnancy.

topics.topic: Septic Arthritis
topics.title: Guideline for management of septic arthritis in native joints (SANJO)
topics.coverageNote: Native-joint septic arthritis guideline. Prosthetic-joint papers were not used.

topics.topic: Septic arthritis: diagnosis, Gram stain, joint aspiration, empirical antibiotics, surgical drainage
topics.title: Guideline for management of septic arthritis in native joints (SANJO)
topics.coverageNote: Same SANJO guideline, with questions on aspiration timing, Gram stain, and drainage.

topics.topic: Shared decision making and patient reported outcomes in rheumatology: HAQ, PROMIS, PROs
topics.title: 2019 Update of the American College of Rheumatology Recommended Rheumatoid Arthritis Disease Activity Measures
topics.coverageNote: Grounds HAQ, PROMIS, and preferred patient-reported disease-activity measures. It does not describe a shared-decision-making method, so none is taught.

topics.topic: Sjogren syndrome: sicca symptoms, anti-Ro, anti-La, MALT lymphoma risk, systemic features
topics.title: Manifestations and management of Sjögren's disease
topics.coverageNote: Covers sicca from glandular hypofunction, anti-Ro, anti-La, systemic disease including ILD, and MALT lymphoma risk.

topics.topic: Spondylolysis and Spondylolisthesis
topics.title: Spondylolysis and Isthmic Spondylolisthesis: A Guide to Diagnosis and Management
topics.coverageNote: Open JABFM review of pars defects, isthmic slip, Meyerding grades, and conservative care. Degenerative spondylolisthesis is named in the classification but is not the focus.

topics.topic: Synovial fluid analysis: WBC thresholds, crystals, viscosity, culture interpretation
topics.title: Guideline for management of septic arthritis in native joints (SANJO)
topics.coverageNote: WBC thresholds, crystals, Gram stain, and culture are in SANJO. Viscosity is explicitly absent and is not invented.

topics.topic: TNF Receptor-Associated Periodic Syndrome
topics.title: Revisiting TNF Receptor-Associated Periodic Syndrome (TRAPS): Current Perspectives
topics.coverageNote: Genetics, attack phenotype, amyloidosis, etanercept, and IL-1 are all in this review.

topics.topic: TNF and IL-17 inhibitors in axSpA: secukinumab, ixekizumab, comparative efficacy
topics.title: Biologic and targeted synthetic therapies in ankylosing spondylitis: a pharmacological review
topics.coverageNote: Comparative statements are the review's own summary, not a head-to-head trial. Trial percentages are those the review reports.

topics.topic: Total joint replacement in OA: indications, outcomes, complications, revision rates
topics.title: Osteoarthritis in over 16s: diagnosis and management (NICE NG226)
topics.coverageNote: Indications for referral are grounded in NG226. Numeric outcomes, complication rates, and revision rates are not in this recommendations chapter and are not invented.

topics.topic: Trochanteric Bursitis
topics.title: Greater trochanteric pain syndrome: Evaluation and management of a wide spectrum of pathology
topics.coverageNote: Trochanteric bursitis is handled as part of GTPS, which is the diagnosis the source says should replace isolated-bursitis labelling.

topics.topic: Urate-lowering therapy: allopurinol, febuxostat, target serum urate, titration
topics.title: Gout: diagnosis and management (NICE NG219)
topics.coverageNote: In-app NICE NG219 recommendations chapter (question-repair source import, guideline document for https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng219). Dose-step tables from the evidence reviews are not in the stored chapter.

topics.topic: methotrexate early rheumatoid arthritis combination therapy TEAR
topics.title: A randomized comparative effectiveness study of oral triple therapy versus etanercept plus methotrexate in early aggressive rheumatoid arthritis: the Treatment of Early Aggressive Rheumatoid Arthritis trial
topics.coverageNote: Early-RA methotrexate strategies in TEAR: immediate combination, step-up at DAS28-ESR ≥3.2, and the primary equivalence of etanercept-methotrexate versus triple therapy.

topics.topic: Cardiac tamponade: Beck's triad, pericardiocentesis, surgical drainage
topics.title: 2015 ESC Guidelines for the diagnosis and management of pericardial diseases
topics.coverageNote: ESC 2015 tamponade section. Beck's triad is not named in the text; the listed signs are used instead. A stored 2024 pericardial-imaging statement did not discuss tamponade.

topics.topic: Meniere's disease: intratympanic therapy, low-salt diet, surgical options
topics.title: Optimal management of Ménière's disease
topics.coverageNote: Covers sodium restriction, intratympanic steroid, endolymphatic surgery, and destructive surgery for Ménière disease. A stored BPPV document was not used.
